sample_unit: survey respondents (medical students and resident doctors); 239 NHS trusts' leaflets reviewed

links.outcome: Readability age of NHS breast cancer leaflets versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Mean readability age of NHS leaflets was 14-15 years, versus national recommended levels of 9-11.
links.quote: The mean readability across NHS leaflets showed a readability age of 14-15 years.

links.outcome: Readability of clinician-developed, LLM-assisted leaflet versus existing leaflets
links.effect: The LLM-assisted leaflet met ages 12-13, closer to recommended 9-11 (FRES +7.72; FKGL -1.96; GFI -2.24; SMOG -1.4; CLI -0.39).
links.quote: The clinician developed, LLM assisted leaflet met ages 12-13, closer to national recommended levels of 9-11.

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted rewriting of patient leaflets to improve readability and cultural inclusivity
Cultural sensitivity training for clinicians on breast concerns

screen.reason: The study uses an LLM to assist in drafting and improving readability of an inclusive patient information leaflet, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
